tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (web server)
tasks.command: PORT=8080 python3 dev/web_viewer/serve_with_headers.py & echo $! > /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid && timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-markers-asr.spec.js --reporter=line; kill $(cat /tmp/dev_web_viewer_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (Vite dev)
tasks.command: USE_VITE=1 USE_VITE_PORT=${USE_VITE_PORT:-5180} timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-markers-asr.spec.js --reporter=line

tasks.label: Run ASR markers Playwright test (Vite self-serve)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'USE_VITE_PORT=${USE_VITE_PORT:-5199}; npx -y vite@^6 --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$USE_VITE_PORT" --strictPort & echo $! > /tmp/vite_dev_server.pid; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:$USE_VITE_PORT/demos/ichika_voice_conversation_demo.html >/dev/null && break || sleep 1; done; EXTERNAL_WEBSERVER=1 NO_WEBSERVER=1 USE_VITE=1 USE_VITE_PORT=$USE_VITE_PORT timeout 900s npx playwright test --project=web_viewer-root-e2e dev/web_viewer/e2e-ultimate-markers-asr.spec.js --reporter=line; kill $(cat /tmp/vite_dev_server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true'
